### `POST /api/v1/bundles`

Create bundle

Creates a draft bundle owned by the caller. Allowed for administrators and for any principal that can read at least one repository; the other bundle routes authorize per bundle (see the release bundles documentation).

**Request body** (required)

`application/json`: object

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `description` | string | no | - |
| `name` | string | no | - |
| `pipeline` | string | no | Name of the promotion pipeline; exclusive with pipeline_id. |
| `pipeline_id` | string | no | - |
| `version` | string | no | - |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | Created | `application/json`: [ReleaseBundle](schemas.md#releasebundle) |
| `default` | Error | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |

### `GET /api/v1/bundles/{name}/{version}/manifest`

Get bundle manifest

The exact JSON document a bundle signature covers (admin only): bundle identity plus its items ordered by digest.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |
| `version` | path | string | yes | - |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Manifest | `application/json`: object |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |
| `404` | Bundle not found | - |

### `GET /api/v1/bundles/{name}/{version}/manifest.asc`

Get bundle manifest signature

Armored detached GPG signature of the manifest; 404 when the bundle was sealed without a key (admin only). Verify with `gpg --verify manifest.json.asc manifest.json`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |
| `version` | path | string | yes | - |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Armored signature | `application/pgp-signature`: string |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |
| `404` | Bundle not found or not signed | - |

### `POST /api/v1/bundles/{name}/{version}/promote`

Promote bundle

Copies every item of a sealed bundle into target_repo and moves the bundle to to_stage (admin only). Items are copied as metadata that references the same stored blobs (no bytes are duplicated), in one transaction: either every item lands and the promotion is recorded, or nothing changes. The target's storage quota is charged, its license policies and immutable_releases setting are enforced, and quarantined source artifacts are refused. An artifact already present in the target with the same content counts as existing (so a retry is idempotent); different content at the same coordinates is a 409. Emits the bundle.promoted webhook event.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |
| `version` | path | string | yes | - |
| `force` | query | boolean | no | Administrators only: `true` replaces content that the target already holds at the same coordinates, including released versions of a repository with `immutable_releases`, instead of answering 409. The replaced rows go to the target's trash. |

**Request body** (required)

`application/json`: object

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `notes` | string | no | - |
| `target_repo` | string | no | Repository to promote into. May be omitted when the pipeline stage fixes a repository. |
| `to_stage` | string | no | - |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Promoted | `application/json`: object |
| `400` | Invalid request, or an item's repository and the target are not hosted repositories of the same format | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `403` | Not an admin; an item is quarantined in its source (ARTIFACT_QUARANTINED); or a license policy of the target blocks it (LICENSE_BLOCKED) | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `404` | Bundle or target repository not found | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `409` | Bundle not sealed or changed concurrently; to_stage does not follow the current stage; an item no longer exists in its source repository (artifact_missing); the target holds different content at the same coordinates (artifact_conflict), or the target has immutable releases and the version is a release (immutable_release) | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `507` | The target repository's storage quota would be exceeded (quota_exceeded) | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `default` | Error | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |

Fields of the `200` response (`application/json`):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `copied` | integer | no | Artifacts newly written to the target |
| `existing` | integer | no | Artifacts the target already held with the same content |
| `items` | array of object | no | - |
| `items[].artifact_path` | string | no | - |
| `items[].copied` | array of object | no | - |
| `items[].copied[].name` | string | no | - |
| `items[].copied[].path` | string | no | - |
| `items[].copied[].sha256` | string | no | - |
| `items[].copied[].size` | integer (int64) | no | - |
| `items[].copied[].version` | string | no | - |
| `items[].existing` | array of object | no | - |
| `items[].existing[].name` | string | no | - |
| `items[].existing[].path` | string | no | - |
| `items[].existing[].sha256` | string | no | - |
| `items[].existing[].size` | integer (int64) | no | - |
| `items[].existing[].version` | string | no | - |
| `items[].format` | string | no | - |
| `items[].replaced` | array of object | no | - |
| `items[].replaced[].name` | string | no | - |
| `items[].replaced[].path` | string | no | - |
| `items[].replaced[].sha256` | string | no | - |
| `items[].replaced[].size` | integer (int64) | no | - |
| `items[].replaced[].version` | string | no | - |
| `items[].sha256` | string | no | - |
| `promotion` | object | no | The recorded bundle promotion (status success) |
| `replaced` | integer | no | Artifacts a forced promotion moved to the target's trash because they held different content |

### `POST /api/v1/bundles/{name}/{version}/seal`

Seal bundle

Seals a draft bundle. With `gpg_key_id` (a key id from the admin GPG list, a fingerprint, or `config`) the bundle manifest is signed and the armored detached signature stored with the bundle (`gpg_key_id` = signer fingerprint, `gpg_signature`). An unknown key answers 400 validation_failed.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |
| `version` | path | string | yes | - |

**Request body** (required)

`application/json`: object

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gpg_key_id` | string | no | - |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Success | `application/json`: [ReleaseBundle](schemas.md#releasebundle) |
| `default` | Error | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
